# Credit expiry and History table — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for Credit expiry and History table. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-24 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## Facts and statements

- [statement] On organization Billing > Overview, Available Credits shows active and upcoming credits; expired credits appear in the History table below it. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/subscriptions.md
- [statement] Available Credits shows usage progress for active credit pools and gray upcoming credits. Atlas draws credits from top to bottom in displayed order. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/subscriptions.md
- [statement] Subscription expiry makes Atlas use the configured payment method for remaining charges and revert subscription-paid support to Basic. Deployments must be terminated to stop future charges. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/subscriptions.md
- [statement] Monthly Commitment unused credits can cover later overages during the subscription term; the documentation does not promise indefinite rollover. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/subscriptions.md
- [statement] MongoDB for Startups gives 12 months to activate a code and 12 months after activation to use its credits. This is a program-specific rule. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://www.mongodb.com/solutions/startups · keywords: Credit expiry and History table · also: https://reconscribe.com/free-credits/startups/
- [statement] For startup credits, Available Credits > Active Dates displays the expiry date. MongoDB considers extension requests individually and suggests contacting the program with three months remaining; codes cover future charges only. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-24) — https://www.mongodb.com/solutions/startups
- [statement] On September 30, 2020, a Reddit user alleged that MongoDB Atlas promo-code expiry dates changed from 2099 to earlier dates, including expired dates; the post described this as affecting existing redeemed codes. This single historical account does not establish current policy. (low confidence) — https://www.reddit.com/r/mongodb/comments/j2qgi3
- [statement] SaaSOffers recommends tracking activation date, expiry date, monthly burn and balance, plus calendar reminders 60 and 14 days before expiry. This is third-party operating advice, not a documented Atlas alert feature. (low confidence) — https://saasoffers.tech/blog/startup-saas-credits-expire
